Minted NFT Viewer Preview

These are the HTML pages stored as animation_url in the NFT metadata. Click the play button to reveal the media player.

Text Thumbnail

generateBrandedThumbnail('text') — blurred bg + 60% shade + logo + text snippet

Image Thumbnail

generateBrandedThumbnail('image') — blurred bg + 60% shade + logo (no text snippet for image type)

Audio Player

buildAudioPlayer() — poster + play button, then audio controls (background persists)

Video Player

buildVideoPlayer() — poster + play button, then full-cover video

3D Interactive Viewer

buildInteractive3DViewer() — poster + play button, then Three.js scene
